implementation: Oracle Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel (UEK6) Cryptographic Module (CTS_CTI_C)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized CBC-CS block mode generation using constant time C AES implementation.
